messages:
emma-prod: FYI — we're planning a controlled A/B rollout next Wednesday to migrate a subset of older accounts to the new per-token price table. Need finance + billing + legal OK before we flip the switch.

maya-fin: +1. Can you paste the cohort rules and the expected delta in ARR? rough numbers are fine.

emma-prod: Cohorts: 5% legacy accounts with >$1k/mo usage (group A, price change), 5% control (group B, no change). Expected immediate $/mo delta: +~$12k on paper, net after churn estimate ~+$9k.

emma-prod: Rollout plan (short):
1) Create cohort lists in billing (export)
2) Apply pricing override for cohort A for 7 days
3) Monitor usage, invoice preview + customer support queue
4) Revert if any unexpected spike in invoice disputes

emma-prod: Pricing override snippet we'll apply:
```
product: "text-generation"
old_price_usd_per_token: 0.0008
new_price_usd_per_token: 0.0010
effective_period: 7d
cohort_tag: "legacy-ab-2026-03"
```

sam-billing: I can generate the cohort export. Two asks: (1) how do you want billing flags set for invoice previews? (2) Do we auto-adjust any prorated invoices?

maya-fin: For invoice previews set a non-billing tag first (preview-only) so we can run reconciliation and let CS review. No auto-prorate — prefer manual adjustments after we validate.

nina-legal: Need to confirm TOS/contractual impacts for accounts on annual commitments. If an account is under a locked annual rate, we can't change invoice prices mid-term without consent. Please add contract status column to the cohort export.

zane-eng: We'll add a feature flag to runtime that gates new pricing per-customer. It will accept cohort_tag and preview=true|false. Preview mode will not emit real charge events. ETA: I can have the flag and integration with billing sandbox done by EOD tomorrow.

liam-data: I'll run a churn-sensitivity check on the selected cohort. Quick estimate: if monthly churn increases by 1ppt vs control, net ARR impact flips negative. I'll attach results to the cohort sheet.

sam-billing: Export request noted. I'll include columns: customer_id, contract_status, billing_contact, billing_currency, monthly_spend_est, support_tier. Will add a preview_flag column for your manual toggles.

maya-fin: Also add a "last_invoice_dispute_count_90d" column — we don't want to test on already-fragile accounts.

emma-prod: Great. Two operational questions: (A) If disputes >3 in 90d exclude from cohort. (B) If legal flags annual-locked accounts, remove them. Internal comms plan: CS gets an email template for preview phase, then a final notice if price changes are committed.

nina-legal: Agreed. Send draft email to me and I'll check for required disclosure language. Also confirm we won't surface the phrase "price increase" for preview emails — use "billing alignment test" phrasing instead.

billing-bot: deploy-preview created: preview_group=legacy-ab-2026-03, users=178, mode=preview_only, created_by=emma-prod

zane-eng: Preview flag is live in staging. I pushed the feature-flag key: ff:new-pricing-preview. Let me know when you want it toggled for production test.

liam-data: Uploaded sensitivity matrix to shared drive: link=https://drive.redwood/sheets/legacy-ab-sensitivity. Quick note — high-usage outliers distort averages, consider median gating.

maya-fin: I'll do the first-pass reconciliation after the preview runs for 48h. If numbers look sane we can greenlight a short billing pilot with real invoices for group A for 7 days.

emma-prod: Timeline recap: cohort export by sam today -> legal review by nina tomorrow morning -> eng feature flag ready EOD -> preview toggle Wed morning -> 48h preview -> finance reconciliation -> decision to go live for 7-day billed pilot.

sam-billing: On it. I'll DM the export link when ready and tag @nina-legal in the sheet.

emma-prod: Thanks team. I'll draft the CS preview email and post it here for sign-off before we send. :thumbsup:
